findings.title: Key file's mode lets others read it, and the app refuses it
findings.cause: container git-sync exits because the app refuses key file /etc/git-secret/ssh: others may read it, and the app wants it private; its mode is 0644 (defaultMode) on volume deploy-key (Secret deploy-key); its log says: "Permissions 0644 for '/etc/git-secret/ssh' are too open."; Deployment git-sync has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.what: container git-sync exited with code 1 (Error), restarted 6 times
last lines of container git-sync's log (run that exited)
evidence.detail:
Permissions 0644 for '/etc/git-secret/ssh' are too open.
It is required that your private key files are NOT accessible by others.

evidence.what: container git-sync mounts volume deploy-key (Secret deploy-key) at /etc/git-secret

findings.fix: Set defaultMode: 0400 on volume deploy-key (or mode: 0400 on the key's item); YAML takes it with the leading zero, JSON as 256.
